title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Lemma L1, conclusion L1.C001.
If x is real and |x|<=1, then x^2<=1.
Proof. Squaring the nonnegative inequality |x|<=1 gives |x|^2<=1, and |x|^2=x^2.
Theorem T1, conclusion T1.C001.
For every real x, x^2<=1.
Proof. Apply Lemma L1 to this arbitrary real x; its conclusion is exactly the desired assertion.
